product.name: Crypto Debit Cards
product.description: Physical or virtual debit cards linked to cryptocurrency wallets allowing users to spend digital assets at merchants accepting debit cards, converting crypto to local currency at purchase.

product.name: Real-Time Payments
product.description: A payment system enabling instant transfer of funds between banks and financial institutions, available 24/7 for immediate transaction processing.

product.description: A privacy-focused application that helps users locate merchants accepting cryptocurrency payments without collecting or processing personal data.
